{{nihongo|'''Sawa Shrine'''|佐波神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

=== Overview ===
Its foundation is unknown, but because it is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}, it dates back to before {{ill|Enchō|de|Enchō|fa|انچو|fr|Ère Enchō|ia|Encho|id|Enchō|ja|延長 (元号)|ko|엔초|ru|Энтё|simple|Enchō|sr|Енчо|tr|Enchō|uk|Ентьо|zh|延長 (日本)|zh_yue|延長 (年號)|qid=Q1327274|lt=Enchō}} 5 ({{ill|927|ab|927|af|927|am|927 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|927|ar|927|ary|927|ast|927|avk|927|az|927|azb|۹۲۷ (میلادی)|bar|927|bcl|927|be|927|be_x_old|927|bg|927|bn|৯২৭|bpy|মারি ৯২৭|br|927|bs|927.|ca|927|cdo|927 nièng|ceb|927|ckb|٩٢٧|crh|927|cs|927|csb|927|cv|927|cy|927|da|927|de|927|el|927|eml|927|eo|927|es|927|et|927|eu|927|fa|۹۲۷ (میلادی)|fi|927|fo|927|fr|927|fy|927|ga|927|gan|927年|gd|927|gl|927|he|927|hi|927|hr|927.|ht|927 (almanak jilyen)|hu|927|hy|927|id|927|ilo|927|io|927|is|927|it|927|ja|927年|jv|927|ka|927|kaa|927|kk|927 жыл|ko|927년|la|927|lb|927|lij|927|lmo|927|lt|927 m.|lv|927. gads|map_bms|927|mdf|927|mg|927|mhr|927|mi|927|mk|927|mr|इ.स. ९२७|mrj|927 и|ms|927|mzn|۹۲۷|nah|927|nap|927|nds|927|new|सन् ९२७|nl|927|nn|927|no|927|nrm|927|nso|927|oc|927|or|୯୨୭|os|927-æм аз|pl|927|pnb|927|pt|927|qu|927|ro|927|ru|927 год|rue|927|sa|९२७|scn|927|sd|927ع|se|927|sh|927.|shn|927|si|927|sk|927|smn|927|sq|927|sr|927|su|927|sv|927|sw|927|tg|Соли 927|th|พ.ศ. 1470|tk|927|tl|927|tly|927|tr|927|tt|927 ел|uk|927|ur|927ء|uz|927|vec|927|vi|927|war|927|wuu|927年|xmf|927|zh|927年|zh_min_nan|927 nî|zh_yue|927年|qid=Q30470}}), when the ''{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}'' was compiled<ref>[https://kotobank.jp/word/神名帳-82644 神名帳とは] - {{ill|Kotobank|ca|Kotobank|es|Kotobank|fa|کوتوبانک|fr|Kotobank|id|Kotobank|it|Kotobank|ja|コトバンク|ko|코토뱅크|pt|Kotobank|zh|Kotobank|zh_yue|Kotobank|qid=Q11302260}}</ref>.

The shrine name “Sawa” shares its origin with the place name “Sawa/澤”<ref name="yuisho"/>.

Originally, Mishima Myōjin and Hachimangū stood side by side by the sea (present-day Nishina Port/Kamogaike Site), but due to a tsunami they were moved to the current site in {{ill|Keichō|ca|Keichō|es|Keichō|fa|کیچو (دوره)|fr|Ère Keichō|id|Keichō|it|Keichō|ja|慶長|ko|게이초|ru|Кэйтё|simple|Keichō|sr|Кеичо|sv|Keichō|th|เคโช|tr|Keichō|uk|Кейтьо|zh|慶長|qid=Q1328185}} 14 ({{ill|1609|Q6762|qid=Q6762}}), and were merged into one shrine in March of {{ill|Bunsei|Q1327119|qid=Q1327119}} 6 ({{ill|1823|Q6988|qid=Q6988}})<ref name="yuisho"/>.

At the annual festival on November 2-3, the “Ningyō {{ill|Sanbasō|Q11356796|qid=Q11356796}},” a prefecturally designated intangible folk cultural property preserved in only five places in the Izu area (three in this town), is performed<ref>[https://www.nishiizu-kankou.com/sightseeing/sawasanbasou 佐波神社三番叟] - Nishiizu Tourism Association</ref><ref>[https://www.pref.shizuoka.jp/kankosports/bunkageijutsu/bunkazai/1002825/1041003/1041888/1004974/1021026.html 仁科の人形三番叟] - Shizuoka Prefecture</ref>. (For reference, the remaining four places are: in town, Ushikoshi Shrine in Ukusu and (Kainano) Shinmei Shrine in central Nishina; outside town, Isuzugawa Shrine in Koura, Minamiizu, and Ogawa Shrine in the Nakaizu area of Izu City<ref>[https://www.nishiizu-kankou.com/sightseeing/ushisanbasou 牛越神社人形三番叟] - Nishiizu Tourism Association</ref><ref>[https://www.pref.shizuoka.jp/kankosports/bunkageijutsu/bunkazai/1002825/1041003/1041888/1004974/1021027.html 海名野神明神社の人形三番叟] - Shizuoka Prefecture</ref><ref>[https://www.pref.shizuoka.jp/kankosports/bunkageijutsu/bunkazai/1002825/1041003/1041888/1004974/1021025.html 人形三番叟] - Shizuoka Prefecture</ref>.)
